name: Bodice
_about: A SHEET ROUND THE TORSO from the collar down to the waist or the hips, following the body: the body of a shirt, a tunic, a kirtle, a doublet. Its NECKLINE is cut from its top (a ball round the collar point: round, scoop, v, square, boat, deeper at the front than the back by `neckFront` and `neckBack`); LACING runs down a narrow strip at its front; a HEM band may border its lower edge.
